content.text:
The grey descriptive text on the home page is now `#3d4650`. The 16 functional tests pass. I haven't checked the page in a browser.

I added a rule at the end of `site/css/pages.css` that sets `--color-muted: #3d4650` on `.page-home main`. Other pages are untouched.

It changes every muted-grey text element inside the home page's `<main>`, not just the hero line. That includes:
- the hero lede
- the stat labels
- the text in the cards
- the newsletter note

The header and footer, which sit outside `<main>`, keep the original grey. If you want those darker too, change the selector to `.page-home`.

STATUS: DONE
